problem_severity_frequency.rationale: Food waste matters, but for consumers a surplus box is a preference competing with ordinary grocery, not a felt, budgeted pain.

buyer_budget_clarity.rationale: Consumers pay directly but the category is low-ticket (£10-£18/box) and price-sensitive, with delivery charged separately.

evidence_strength.rationale: Four years of reported incumbent accounts from the trade press give a strong read on category economics; no primary buyer evidence.

distribution.rationale: DTC grocery requires paid acquisition; Oddbox stopped marketing and revenue fell, showing the weakness of organic routes.

differentiation.rationale: Oddbox (scale, £30m raised) and Wonky Veg Boxes already occupy the surplus-produce position; no distinct wedge.

validation_speed_cost.rationale: A single-city pre-order test is possible, but a decisive read on retention and unit economics takes months, not days.

feasibility.rationale: Operable, but cold-chain/logistics and spoilage make execution materially harder than software-only ideas.

economics.rationale: Category leader is loss-making at ~£27m revenue after ~£30m raised, with operating losses widening 98.7% in FY2025.

founder_fit.rationale: No evidence recorded about founder access to growers, logistics or retail; left unscored rather than guessed.

risk.rationale: Food-handling and packaging risks are standard, but churn and capital intensity are structural and unresolved.

economic_buyer.note: Consumers pay directly and the purchase is frequent.

painful_frequent_or_budgeted.note: Weekly grocery is frequent and budgeted, though food-waste reduction is a preference rather than a need.

non_paid_distribution.note: DTC grocery requires paid acquisition; Oddbox cut marketing to new customers and revenue then fell.

defensible_wedge.note: Oddbox and Wonky Veg Boxes occupy the surplus-produce position; a local variant is not defensible against them.

no_network_effects_needed.note: A single subscriber gets full value; no network requirement.

plausible_margins.note: Category leader is loss-making at scale; delivery, spoilage and churn keep margins implausible.

acceptable_risk.note: Food safety/handling and packaging are manageable with standard practices.

cheap_disconfirming_test.note: A single-city pre-order and retention test is cheap to start.

not_all_optimistic.note: Requires favourable CAC, retention and delivery density simultaneously against a funded incumbent.
